about_the_game:
"A miko, a nun, and a cop walk into a bar ran by a succubus.

Wait, what kind of joke is this?!"

Devil's Draw is a NSFW cardgame inspired by PurpleCrit's Succubus Roulette and by extension Buckshot Roulette. 

Sakie the succubus invites 3 women to her club to play her magical sex game, Devil's Draw. When the cards are drawn one of two things happen, either money appears, or demons are summoned to pleasure the one who received the card. Teach those girls about life's baser pleasures and give them a new, more sex positive outlook on life!

Gameplay 

On your turn you draw the top card of the deck,

and based on how many Lust cards you know are in the deck, decide who gets it.

Give it to yourself and you get to draw again, your turn ends if you give it to your opponent.
The cards either gift money or pleasure to the one who recieved the card, and you continue until one of you gives in to the pleasure.  And it all happens in front of the club's adoring audience!

Items are also added to spice things up.
skip your opponents turn, confuse them so they make a bad choice, heal up, or destroy your opponents items.

The game only needs a mouse to play. as everything is either click or drag and drop.

Bonuses

You can spend the money you earned in games to add more toys to the available pool and unlock bonuses such as a brick breaker minigame and the gallery.

The game should only 40 minutes or so to beat each girl's scenario and see all the content.
